_comment: Public web endpoints an external stakeholder must be able to open with NO credentials. Checked by public-endpoint-health.py. Every entry declares the objective it serves — an endpoint nobody can name an objective for is a candidate for retirement, not for monitoring.

_criteria.require_text: string that MUST be present; its absence means the page silently regressed to a placeholder
_criteria.max_latency_ms: budget above which a WARN is raised (default 8000)
_criteria.min_size_bytes: below this the response is treated as a stub (default 400)
_criteria.follow_links: verify every same-origin link resolves — set true for hub/index pages
